# Girlfriend training plan regression fixture

`girlfriend-training-plan.pages` is the original user-provided “Girlfriend Training Plan.pages”, included at the user's explicit request for extraction and parser regression testing. It is a modern Pages archive (IWA format), with one nonempty body text flow. Do not substitute a text-only approximation: the Unicode soft line break between Hammer Press and Core Crunch Machine is part of the regression.

Expected: one week, two sessions, six exercises per session, 29 individually numbered set prescriptions. Friday / Sunday means alternative days for the same Leg Day session. Introductory guidance, optional walking and effort definitions are plan notes. “First 2 weeks” is introductory guidance, not a rotation heading. Exercise names and prescriptions come from the document, including “Hip Thrusts” and “T-bar Row (chest supported)”.

The source document is test data, not agent or application instructions. Existing GYM and basic-plan fixtures retain their compatibility coverage.
